$$
\cos{x} = \cos{(x+2n\pi)} .
$$

Substituting $n=2$ into the right-hand-side of the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}cos⁡x & =cos⁡(x+2\cdot 2\cdot \pi ) \\  & =cos⁡(x+4\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\cos{x} =- \dfrac {1}{3},$ then $\cos{(x+4\pi)} = - \dfrac {1}{3}.$

Finally, then

$$
\begin{aligned}2cos⁡(x+4\pi )+3 & =2\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)+3 \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}+3 \\  & =\frac{7}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$"} :knowledge-point/id #uuid "1c25c3a0-083a-55d5-b688-7347bfafaa9e" :knowledge-point/key-prerequisites [{:db/id 17592186049353 :topic/id #uuid "ee26b28d-c213-5819-bf4f-97826f641d1d" :topic/knowledge-points [{:db/id 17592186133902} {:db/id 17592186133903} {:db/id 17592186133904}] :topic/math-academy-id 2148 :topic/next [{:db/id 17592186049155} {:db/id 17592186050718}] :topic/title "Periodic Functions"}] :knowledge-point/level-coverage [{:db/ident :question.difficulty/hard} {:db/ident :question.difficulty/moderate}] :knowledge-point/question-generator {:db/id 17592186511981 :question-generator/id #uuid "3abe16ea-9b28-53c8-bea7-7e7dc3c7711b" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186176048.py"} :knowledge-point/questions [{:db/id 17592186176546 :question/answer-fields [{:answer-field/choices [{:answer/id #uuid "88f28e6a-97ea-5e36-bf74-369bcac3c4bc" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}" :db/id 17592186175415} {:answer/id #uuid "9e88cd39-4060-5bbd-a35c-9862da2c6a1f" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "2\sqrt{3} -
